description: This file is part of the rusEfi project and contains implementation code for advanced mapping of ignition timing in an engine control system. It includes functions for computing advance angles based on RPM, engine load, temperature sensors, and various configuration parameters. It also manages timing maps, corrections, and specific calculations for cranking and idle conditions.

classes.name: ign_Map3D_t
classes.description: 3D ignition map used to store advance values based on RPM and load.

classes.name: ign_tps_Map3D_t
classes.description: TPS-adjusted 3D ignition map, used for advance based on throttle position.

methods.name: isStep1Condition
methods.description: Checks if the engine RPM meets conditions for step 1 limiter to be enabled.

methods.name: getRunningAdvance
methods.description: Calculates the ignition advance angle based on current RPM and engine load during normal running conditions.

methods.name: getAdvanceCorrections
methods.description: Computes total ignition timing corrections based on intake air temperature, engine sensors, and correction maps.

methods.name: getCrankingAdvance
methods.description: Calculates ignition advance for cranking conditions, possibly interpolated for faster starts.

methods.name: getAdvance
methods.description: Determines the final ignition advance angle considering cranking or running conditions, including corrections.

methods.name: setDefaultIatTimingCorrection
methods.description: Initializes IAT timing correction curve and tables.

methods.name: initTimingMap
methods.description: Initializes the ignition timing maps based on configuration tables and parameters.

methods.name: getTopAdvanceForBore
methods.description: Calculates maximum ignition advance based on engine bore, octane, compression, and chamber style.

methods.name: getAdvanceForRpm
methods.description: Provides an approximate ignition advance based on RPM linear interpolation.

methods.name: getInitialAdvance
methods.description: Computes initial ignition advance based on RPM and engine load with heuristics.

methods.name: buildTimingMap
methods.description: Builds default timing map based on engine algorithms, RPMs, and load bins.
